notes.subject: התמיד
notes.rationale: 'samting bilong oltaim' — ol tanim tok i tok 'daily sacrifice' o 'continual burnt-offering'; Hibru i no gat tok 'ofa' o 'evride' long en

notes.subject: וממנו
notes.rationale: 'long em' — man i no save: long prins (KJV 'by him') o long liklik kuan; mi holim long prins

notes.subject: prins bilong ol ami
notes.rationale: wanem man em i stap hait yet long ves — vision i no klia

translation: Na em i Save rangre long prins bilong ol ami, na ol i rausim long em ⟨את⟩ ofa bilong oltaim, na ples we i stap long holi ples bilong em i tromoi i go daun.

tokens.gloss: na i tromoi i go daun
